 Prime Video India adds Sony LIV as add-on subscription in landmark streaming partnership
 Amazon's Prime Video has teamed up with Sony LIV to offer an integrated subscription service for users in India. With this partnership, viewers can now access a diverse range of shows and movies, including popular originals and live sports events like cricket and the UEFA Champions League, all within a single app.

 Highlights
 Sony LIV now available as an add-on on Amazon Prime Video.
 The integration includes blockbusters and live sports coverage.
 Viewers can subscribe without switching between apps.
 Prime Video India adds Sony LIV as add-on subscription in landmark streaming partnership Amazon's Prime Video has announced the integration of Sony LIV as an add-on subscription on its platform, bringing blockbusters, original series, and live sports into a single entertainment hub.
The partnership allows Prime Video customers in India to subscribe to Sony LIV directly through the platform, eliminating the need to switch between apps.
 The offering includes originals like the Scam franchise and Gullak, daily television shows such as Kaun Banega Crorepati and Indian Idol, and live sports coverage spanning bilateral cricket, the UEFA Champions League, and the French Open.
 Advt 
 Gaurav Bhasin, head of AVOD business and marketplace, Prime Video India , said, "Our ambition has always been to make Prime Video the ultimate entertainment destination for our customers. With Sony LIV now available as an add-on subscription, we take a significant step forward in that journey."
 Rajesh Kaul, chief revenue officer and business head - sports and international, SPNI, added, "Our partnership with Prime Video is an important step in expanding that reach in India. It gives viewers another convenient way to discover and access Sony LIV's diverse content offering."
